evidence.quote: The Kestrelwood spectrograph is now calibrated at 88.4 MHz.

observations.why: Flat unhedged declarative stating a calibration result — asserted as fact, but no ratification or operational language to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote:
We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it
holds across the full observing band.

observations.why: First-person verification with supporting evidence, but still an asserted-and-defensible position rather than a settled operational rule.
Explicit ratification language labeling these as decisions the group has settled on and expects to act upon — the document itself performs the settling.
